info.maxtech.energy.brownout: Brownout: machines get %s%% of their demand
info.maxtech.energy.network: Energy network: %s MU/t supply, %s MU/t demand
info.maxtech.energy.paused: Paused: part of the network is in unloaded chunks
info.maxtech.mode_glyph.extract: with an arrow out of the block
info.maxtech.mode_glyph.insert: with an arrow into the block
maxtech_lib.config_screen.restart.game: Applies after the game is restarted
maxtech_lib.config_screen.restart.world: Applies after the world is reloaded
Mark what cable colours say in shape too: the dye's letter on a dyed cable, an arrow or diamond for a connector's mode, and both in words in the Jade overlay. Reload the chunks (F3+A) after changing it.
maxtech_lib.configuration.energy.edgePol: FE has no change signal: while no energy flows to or from another mod's block, its edge looks at it again every this many ticks (and at once when the block is placed or removed).
maxtech_lib.configuration.energy.exportE: Whether MaxTech energy may flow out to other mods' blocks (their FE machines and batteries). Off, networks still take FE in from other mods, but give none out.
maxtech_lib.configuration.energy.exportP: Most MU per tick one other mod's block next to a MaxTech energy block may be sent; 0 for no limit. Also limits how much one MaxTech block hands out through its FE capability per tick.
Most MU per tick one energy network sends to other mods' blocks in total; 0 for no limit.
maxtech_lib.configuration.energy.feRateF: Exchange rate between FE and MaxTech Units (MU): feRateFe FE are worth feRateMu MU. Both directions round down, so converting back and forth never creates energy.
maxtech_lib.configuration.energy.feRateM: MU side of the FE exchange rate; see feRateFe.
maxtech_lib.configuration.facades.showCo: Show the cables inside a facaded cable, instead of the facade, while holding a wrench or a cable.
maxtech_lib.configuration.highlights.ren: Outlines and overlay lines (locate, network analyzer) farther away than this many blocks are not drawn.
maxtech_lib.configuration.networks.allow: Whether network anchors may keep the chunks of their network loaded.
maxtech_lib.configuration.networks.unloa: truncate: networks only span loaded chunks and reconnect when a chunk loads. pause: a network that reaches into an unloaded chunk stops until all its chunks are loaded.
maxtech_lib.configuration.overlay.detail: How much the Jade overlay shows for MaxTech blocks: compact (status and the most important number) or full (every detail, always).
maxtech_lib.configuration.overlay.sneakF: Show every detail while Jade's "show details" key (sneak by default) is held. Only matters with the compact detail level.
maxtech_lib.configuration.preset.tooltip: Default bundle for the values below: standalone, pack, custom, or the name of a JSON file in config/maxtech_lib/presets/. Values you edit are kept; untouched values follow the preset, also across mod updates. custom never changes any value.
maxtech_lib.configuration.scheduler.maxB: Longest sleep of an idle device between two checks; the sleep doubles from 1 tick with each idle check. Events (an inventory change, a click) wake devices at once.
maxtech_lib.configuration.scheduler.owne: Microseconds of tick time one owner (such as a storage network) may spend on its devices per tick; work beyond that waits for the next tick, so the owner slows down, not the server.
Operations one owner may run per tick (each device run counts one, plus what it moves in batches); the same throttle as the time budget, but independent of the machine's speed.
maxtech_lib.configuration.security.opsBy: Whether game masters (permission level 2) can always open and use owned machines and containers. Off, only the owner, trusted players and team members get in.
maxtech_lib.configuration.sync.listUpdat: Most times per second a large list on an open screen (a storage terminal) receives its changes; changes in between are merged. The full list is sent once when the screen opens.
maxtech_lib.configuration.text.scale.too: Text size on MaxTech screens, independent of the GUI scale: normal, large (1.25x) or larger (1.5x).
maxtech_lib.configuration.transfer.energ: Most energy (MU) one operation of a transfer port moves through one face.
maxtech_lib.configuration.transfer.filte: Most entries (resources and tags) a player can put in one transfer port filter.
maxtech_lib.configuration.transfer.fluid: Most fluid (mB) one operation of a transfer port moves through one face.
maxtech_lib.configuration.transfer.items: Most items one operation of a transfer port moves through one face.
maxtech_lib.configuration.transfer.minIn: Fewest ticks between two operations of one transfer port; ports sleep longer while idle.
maxtech_lib.configuration.workers.thread: Background threads for planning and searches on snapshots; read when the server starts.
tooltip.maxtech.jade.more: ...and %s more; use a scanner for the rest
tooltip.maxtech.scanner: Use on a block to print its stats and network to chat.
